reviews.review: at the time i played this game , i cant remember it having a single player
what destiny wanted to be in multiple dlcs and games. but for free. destiny is booooooooring.
While I do reccommend playing this game, I do not recommend expecting much from the developers, and do not invest your money into it, as you will just end up disappointed.

The game about space ninjas without actual ninjas, they're more like gun-blazing killing machines that are extremly fun and addicting to play with. Beautiful art style, interactive devs and a crap tonn of grind.
With multiple ways to do a single mission be it with friends clan mates or by yourself, a game where you can literally play how you like it.
The setting and art desgin is beautiful and one of the primary reasons for me to start playing this game.
The grind is real and can often be frustrating to achive a single target/goal, but it's exremly rewarding and quite satisfying when you finally get it.
Even tho the game lacks a proper story and there is so much potential and it's just so rich with lore. But seeing as the game is still in Beta after +3yrs I'm confident we're not getting a proper story anytime soon.
A game where once you get the hang of it you can truly feel like an OP tank running over obstacles with thousands of ways to kill and wreak havock upon your enemies each of them different and unique from frame to frame.
There is no real "Endgame" to Warframe beside the one true Fashion-frame, thats mostly the reason why most people sink thousands of hours into this game and then feel salty about it because there is no real satisfaction of finishing a game.
The community is one of the more nicer ones I've experienced in online gaming, people are very helpful and the game encourages playing with more people cuz more loot more exp etc. And once you join a clan you can get to know so many people you can learn so much from and get support from time to time.
The trade chat is definatly one of the most intriguing part of this game as we can make plat (in game money) off of it or simply exchange parts for what we need with other players to avoid griding for what we want, it can also be used as a great way to make that ingame money to avoid a lot of grind.
Things often change and it upsets a lot of people *rip ash* but it's a game and honestly what are you gonna do about it, it's not built to make everyone happy it is what it is and some players have a hard time coping to the changes.

Overall it's a beautiful game and possibly one of the best F2P games out there, and the option to pay-2-skip is amazing for those who can't be arsed with the grind or having to deal with RNGesus.
